title: 3.1.10 Lab: Refactor the Receipt Header
description: The starter prints a repeated header three times. Rewrite it so the header lives in one function, called three times, with the output unchanged. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Spot the repetition
steps.instructions: The starter logs the same header line three times, once before each book. That is the repetition to remove.

steps.title: Define printHeader
steps.instructions: Define a parameterless function called printHeader that logs the header line exactly once, inside the function body.

steps.title: Call it three times
steps.instructions: Replace each of the three inline header logs with a call to printHeader(), keeping the three book lines exactly where they were.

requirements.title: printHeader defined, no parameters
requirements.description: Code defines a function named printHeader with an empty parameter list

requirements.title: header text lives inside printHeader
requirements.description: printHeader()'s body logs the header line

requirements.title: printHeader called three times
requirements.description: printHeader() is called three separate times

requirements.title: all three books still printed
requirements.description: The three distinct book titles are still logged, in order
